notes: The vocative *ye* is written immediately before the vocative noun rather than after the imperative, so it is the noun's and not the verb's subject pronoun (rule 36).
The waw takes the connective *therefore*, the unit discontinuous under rule 25 (rule 14).
The marginal *Or, Oh that thou wouldest slay* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
